---
title: "CCMI Year 2 launch event"
author: "Colin Cotter"
date: "10/06/2026"
summary: "The second year of CCMI kicked off with a great seminar from Anna-Karin Tornberg."
categories: [News]

---

This week we welcomed our second cohort of CCMI PhD researchers, who
are very excited to start. We hosted [Professor Anna-Karin Tornberg
(KTH)](https://www.kth.se/profile/akto) who gave a fantastic talk
about new methods to solve the grand challenge problem of simulating
large numbers of interacting bodies moving in a viscous fluid. It was
great to hear about how concrete physical ideas can translate to
efficient algorithms. Anna-Karin also gave some words of advice and
encouragement to our students about AI and what it means for computational
modelling research.
